title: PAL Clink Audit Output
description: Normalized output from a single PAL clink audit invocation (claude-audit or gemini-audit).

cli_name.description: Logical name of the CLI that ran (e.g. 'claude-audit').

exit_code.description: Process exit code, or null when timed_out is true or pre-flight failed.

timed_out.description: True when the subprocess was killed after the configured timeout.

error.description: Human-readable error string for pre-flight failures or timeout; null on clean invocation.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from subprocess start to completion or timeout; null when pre-flight failed.
